title: Activity Diagram — Manage Operational Exceptions
preconditions: 2. Supported unplanned event occurs after publication/during daily operation.
3. Event can be classified in approved exception scope and affected context can be identified.

nodes.label: Start
Facility actor records operational event and doctor/session/release context
Create OPEN OperationalException with approved type and link affected context
Exception type = SESSION_CANCELLED?
Make affected session/release non-bookable and release active ReservationHolds
Preserve all confirmed Appointments and identify affected unresolved set
Present affected Appointments and relevant hold/capacity state
Select one unresolved affected Appointment
Approved resolution path?
Offer / secure suitable equivalent alternative after Patient communication using reschedule invariants
Cancel Appointment from facility side and preserve history
Electronic amount collected?
Initiate full collected-amount refund
Record facility-cancellation outcome with no electronic refund
Create documented support escalation for later Platform review
Record completed resolution action / outcome for affected Appointment
Keep OperationalException OPEN pending escalated resolution; do not close
More affected Appointments unresolved?
Notify affected Patients through Notification Service when required
Facility actor requests Close Operational Exception
Every affected Appointment has a completed documented action/outcome?
Reject closure and identify remaining resolution requirement
Close OperationalException and preserve audit trail
End-path merge
End

edges.meaning: Session becomes non-bookable; release active holds
Escalation is not a completed resolution
End current activity with exception still OPEN
All completed outcomes documented; notify if required

binding_business_rules: Doctor does not record delay/absence through Doctor interface; facility staff records the OperationalException.
Platform Administrator appears only in later escalation review, not daily operational handling.
Facility-responsible paid cancellation starts full refund.
explicitly_forbidden: Platform Administrator running daily facility resolution.
qa_gates: 1. Verify the exact Use Case title and scope.
2. Verify the Initial Node exists and has no incoming flow.
3. Verify the Activity Final exists and has no outgoing flow.
4. Verify every Action is source-supported and verb-led.
5. Verify every Decision has meaningful guarded outgoing flows.
6. Verify every Merge is used only to reunite alternatives, not as decoration.
7. Verify Fork/Join is absent unless true parallelism is explicitly required.
8. Verify all arrows are Control Flows unless an Object Flow is explicitly specified.
10. Verify no Sequence lifeline/message notation appears.
11. Verify actor permissions and product boundaries.
12. Verify independent lifecycle states are not collapsed into one generic status.
13. Verify all rendered branch guards are mutually understandable and not contradictory.
14. Render SVG/PNG/PDF; open every actual output and inspect it visually.
15. Compare the render against this MD item-by-item and correct semantic, notation, routing, and readability issues.
